16369-fishing-with-a-worm.title: Fishing With A Worm
16369-fishing-with-a-worm.creator: Bliss Perry
16369-fishing-with-a-worm.description: A book by Bliss Perry. panes--in order to varnish a certain fly-rod. Now rods ought to be put in order in September, when the fishing closes, or else in April, when it opens. To varnish a rod in December proves that one possesses either a dilatory or a childishly anticipatory mind. But before uncorking the varnish bottle, it occurred to me to examine a dog-eared, water-stained fly-book, to guard against the ravages of possible moths.

19959-the-mabinogion-vol-1.title: The Mabinogion Vol 1
19959-the-mabinogion-vol-1.creator: Unknown
19959-the-mabinogion-vol-1.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. In this new edition of Lady Guest's translation I have put, in the form of footnotes, what appears to me to be a more correct or a more literal rendering of some of the passages of the Welsh. This course makes it unnecessary to tamper with the charming translation that has become a classic of the English language.

arxiv-2101-02485.title: On the shear-driven surfactant layer instability
arxiv-2101-02485.creator: Aleksey Mizev, Andrey Shmyrov, Anastasia Shmyrova
arxiv-2101-02485.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Aleksey Mizev, Andrey Shmyrov, Anastasia Shmyrova. The structure and stability of the convective flow generated by a source located at the water surface containing an insoluble surfactant layer are experimentally investigated. Application of a few types of source, which differ in the force driving the interface, and two surfactants with different rheological properties made it possible to generalize the results and to develop a unified approach to describing the flow patterns observed in this study.

arxiv-2401-05896.title: The Role of Deep Learning in Advancing Proactive Cybersecurity Measures for Smart Grid Networks: A Survey
arxiv-2401-05896.creator: Nima Abdi, Abdullatif Albaseer, Mohamed Abdallah
arxiv-2401-05896.description: Abstract As smart grids (SG) increasingly rely on advanced technologies like sensors and communication systems for efficient energy generation, distribution, and consumption, they become enticing targets for sophisticated cyber-attacks. These evolving threats demand robust security measures to maintain the stability and resilience of modern energy systems.

arxiv-2502-18423.title: Retrieval Dexterity: Efficient Object Retrieval in Clutters with Dexterous Hand
arxiv-2502-18423.creator: Fengshuo Bai, Yu Li, Jie Chu, Tawei Chou, Runchuan Zhu, Ying Wen, Yaodong Yang, Yuanpei Chen
arxiv-2502-18423.description: Abstract Retrieving objects buried beneath multiple objects is not only challenging but also time-consuming. Performing manipulation in such environments presents significant difficulty due to complex contact relationships. Existing methods typically address this task by sequentially grasping and removing each occluding object, resulting in lengthy execution times and requiring impractical grasping capabilities for every occluding object.

arxiv-2508-14285.title: Amortized Bayesian Meta-Learning for Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
arxiv-2508-14285.creator: Liyi Zhang, Jake Snell, Thomas L. Griffiths
arxiv-2508-14285.description: Abstract Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) with low-rank adaptaion (LoRA) is a cost-effective way to incorporate information from a specific dataset. However, it is often unclear how well the fine-tuned LLM will generalize, i.e., how well it will perform on unseen datasets.

arxiv-2509-14950.title: Ghost Imaging with Free Electron-Photon Pairs
arxiv-2509-14950.creator: Sergei Bogdanov †, Alexander Preimesberger †, Harsh Mishra, Dominik Hornof, Thomas Spielauer, Florian Thajer, Max Maurer, Pia Falb, Leo Stöger, Thomas Schachinger, Friedrich Bleicher, Michael S. Seifner, Isobel C. Bicket, Philipp Haslinger
arxiv-2509-14950.description: Abstract Coincidence imaging, also known as ghost imaging, is a technique that exploits correlations between two particles to reconstruct information about a specimen. The particle that relays the spatial information about the object remains completely non-interacting, while the particle used to probe the object is not spatially resolved.

arxiv-2510-08377.title: UniVideo : Unified Understanding, Generation, and Editing for Videos
arxiv-2510-08377.creator: Cong Wei, Quande Liu, Zixuan Ye, Qiulin Wang, Xintao Wang, [0.3em] Pengfei Wan, Kun Gai, Wenhu Chen, [0.5em] University of Waterloo
arxiv-2510-08377.description: Abstract Unified multimodal models have shown promising results in multimodal content generation and editing but remain largely limited to the image domain. In this work, we present UniVideo , a versatile framework that extends unified modeling to the video domain.

arxiv-2512-04663.title: Fermionic neural Gibbs states
arxiv-2512-04663.creator: Jannes Nys, Juan Carrasquilla
arxiv-2512-04663.description: Abstract We introduce fermionic neural Gibbs states (fNGS), a variational framework for modeling finite-temperature properties of strongly interacting fermions. fNGS starts from a reference mean-field thermofield-double state and uses neural-network transformations together with imaginary-time evolution to systematically build strong correlations.

arxiv-2601-18993.title: FreeOrbit4D: Training-Free Arbitrary Camera Redirection for Monocular Videos via Geometry-Complete 4D Reconstruction
arxiv-2601-18993.creator: Wei Cao, Hao Zhang, Fengrui Tian, Yulun Wu, Yingying Li, Shenlong Wang, Ning Yu, Yaoyao Liu
arxiv-2601-18993.description: Abstract Camera redirection aims to replay a dynamic scene from a single monocular video under a user-specified camera trajectory. However, large-angle redirection is inherently ill-posed: a monocular video captures only a narrow spatio-temporal view of a dynamic 3D scene, providing highly partial observations of the underlying 4D world.

arxiv-2602-15944.title: Towards a classification of graded unitary 𝒲 3 \mathcal{W}_{3} algebras
arxiv-2602-15944.creator: Christopher Beem and, Harshal Kulkarni
arxiv-2602-15944.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Christopher Beem and, Harshal Kulkarni. We study constraints imposed by four-dimensional unitarity (formalised as graded unitarity in recent work by the first author) on possible 𝒲 3 {\mathcal{W}}_{3} vertex algebras arising from four-dimensions via the SCFT/VOA correspondence.

pmc-10608997.title: A Design Methodology for Fault-Tolerant Neuromorphic Computing Using Bayesian Neural Network
pmc-10608997.creator: Di Gao, Xiaoru Xie, Dongxu Wei
pmc-10608997.description: Memristor crossbar arrays are a promising platform for neuromorphic computing. In practical scenarios, the synapse weights represented by the memristors for the underlying system are subject to process variations, in which the programmed weight when read out for inference is no longer deterministic but a stochastic distribution.

pmc-11510725.title: First Report of Trypanosoma vivax (Duttonella), Babesia bovis and Babesia bigemina DNA in Cattle from the Galapagos Islands, Ecuador, and Its Relationship with Anaplasma marginale
pmc-11510725.creator: María Augusta Chávez-Larrea, Cristina Cholota-Iza, Michelle Yugcha-Diaz, Jorge Ron-Román, Freddy Proaño-Pérez, Alicia Maya-Delgado, Jimmy Jumbo-Moreira, Armando Reyna-Bello, Claude Saegerman, Geoff Hide, José María Alunda
pmc-11510725.description: Bovine trypanosomoses, caused by Trypanosoma vivax, is a disease present in African and South American countries. This haemoflagellate protozoan parasite, as well as Anaplasma marginale and Babesia spp., are microorganisms that have a blood tropism, mainly causing fever and anaemia, which reduces the productive capacity of dairy or meat farms. This study aimed to detect T.

pmc-11526665.title: A single risk assessment for the most common diseases of ageing, developed and validated on 10 cohort studies
pmc-11526665.creator: Md Hamidul Huque, Scherazad Kootar, Kim M. Kiely, Craig S. Anderson, Martin van Boxtel, Henry Brodaty, Perminder S. Sachdev, Michelle Carlson, Annette L. Fitzpatrick, Rachel A. Whitmer, Miia Kivipelto, Louisa Jorm, Sebastian Köhler, Nicola T. Lautenschlager, Oscar L. Lopez, Jonathan E. Shaw, Fiona E
pmc-11526665.description: BackgroundWe aimed to develop risk tools for dementia, stroke, myocardial infarction (MI), and diabetes, for adults aged ≥ 65 years using shared risk factors.MethodsData were obtained from 10 population-based cohorts (N = 41,755) with median follow-up time (years) for dementia, stroke, MI, and diabetes of 6.2, 7.0, 6.8, and 7.4, respectively.

pmc-11573582.title: Flexibility and sensitivity in gene regulation out of equilibrium
pmc-11573582.creator: Sara D. Mahdavi, Gabriel L. Salmon, Patill Daghlian, Hernan G. Garcia, Rob Phillips
pmc-11573582.description: SignificanceGrowing theoretical and experimental evidence demonstrates that cells can (and do) spend biochemical energy while regulating their genes. Here, we explore the impact of departing from equilibrium in simple networks known to pervade biology. We learn that beyond increasing sensitivity, dissipation can unlock more flexible input–output behaviors that are otherwise forbidden without spending energy.

pmc-11679013.title: New Challenges in Bladder Cancer Diagnosis: How Biosensing Tools Can Lead to Population Screening Opportunities
pmc-11679013.creator: Fabiana Tortora, Antonella Guastaferro, Simona Barbato, Ferdinando Febbraio, Amelia Cimmino
pmc-11679013.description: Bladder cancer is one of the most common cancers worldwide. Despite its high incidence, cystoscopy remains the currently used diagnostic gold standard, although it is invasive, expensive and has low sensitivity. As a result, the cancer diagnosis is mostly late, as it occurs following the presence of hematuria in urine, and population screening is not allowed.

pmc-12847879.title: Effectiveness of the 2024–2025 KP.2 COVID-19 vaccines in the United States during long-term follow-up
pmc-12847879.creator: George N Ioannou, Kristin Berry, Lei Yan, Yuan Huang, Hung-Mo Lin, David Bui, Denise M Hynes, Edward J Boyko, Jacqueline M Ferguson, Mihaela Aslan, Kristina L Bajema
pmc-12847879.description: Up-to-date estimates of COVID-19 vaccine effectiveness (VE) are needed to inform COVID-19 vaccination strategies and recommendations. This target trial emulation study aimed to estimate the long-term vaccine effectiveness (VE) of the 2024-2025 COVID-19 vaccines targeting the KP.2 Omicron variant within the Veterans Health Administration. The study population (90.9% male, mean age 70.7 years) included 538,631 pairs of vaccinated (i.e.

pmc-12849464.title: Association between serum osmolality trajectories and mortality in sepsis patients: a retrospective multi-cohort study
pmc-12849464.creator: Kun Fang, Jiacheng Shen, Bangchuan Hu, Ziqiang Shao, Li Li
pmc-12849464.description: BackgroundSepsis commonly leads to fluid and electrolyte imbalances, often reflected in abnormal serum osmolality. Although static measurements of osmolality have been investigated, the prognostic significance of dynamic changes in serum osmolality over time remains poorly understood in patients with sepsis.

pmc-13059914.title: Digital support for chronic dyspnoea management in primary care: protocol for the BREATHE (Breathlessness Rapid Evaluation and Therapy) cluster randomised controlled trial
pmc-13059914.creator: Allison Martin, Anthony Paulo Sunjaya, Katrina Giskes, Zoe McKeough, Charlotte M Hespe, Clare Arnott, Laurent Billot, Anna Campain, Caroline Polak Scowcroft, Emily R Atkins, Stephen Jan, Hayley A Scott, Ai-Vee Chua, Christine R Jenkins, on behalf of the BREATHE Investigators
pmc-13059914.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionChronic dyspnoea is a prevalent symptom, and primary care is ideally placed to identify and manage it. However, chronic dyspnoea is under-reported by patients and can be a diagnostic dilemma for practitioners. A fully automated system of patient screening, coupled with a clinical decision support system (CDSS) that uses a validated and evidence-based dyspnoea algorithm, may improve detection, diagnosis and management of the condition. There is currently no CDSS validated for chronic dyspnoea diagnosis and management in primary care in Australia.

pmc-13257569.title: Coupled Enrichment of Cu and Sn at the Oxide/Steel Interface and Its Regulation by Si in Recycled Steels
pmc-13257569.creator: Jiahao Qiang, Fangbo Yang, Yuhe Huang, Jun Lu, Shuize Wang, Xinping Mao
pmc-13257569.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The accumulation of residual elements such as Cu and Sn in recycled steels has become an increasingly critical issue, as their enrichment during high-temperature oxidation can lead to surface hot shortness and deterioration of surface quality. In this work, the coupled enrichment behavior of Cu and Sn at the oxide/steel interface and its regulation by Si were systematically investigated through high-temperature oxidation experiments and microstructural characterization.

pmc-13392239.title: Supramolecular nanofiber stabilization of microdroplets enables ultra-sensitive virus infection analysis
pmc-13392239.creator: Noriyuki Uchida, Atsuya Yaguchi, Shiori Kondo, Kazuyoshi Muranishi, Haruka Kawabata, Haruka Umezawa, Naito Ishimoto, Michiko Tajiri, Satoko Akashi, Takuya Seki, Go Watanabe, Ayano Yoshida, Genki Higuchi, Jakuei Fu, Takanobu Takenouchi, Daisuke Yoshino, Hirotsugu Hiramatsu, Masaki Okumura, Tomohide S
pmc-13392239.description: Aqueous two-phase system (ATPS) droplets in cells act as fluidic microreactors by concentrating biomacromolecules. Inspired by this phenomenon, dextran-rich microdroplets formed in an ATPS with polyethylene glycol have been explored as artificial microreactors for sensitive detection and spatiotemporal control of biochemical reactions. However, the rapid fusion of the microdroplets into bulk phase separation has limited practical applications of this approach.

pmc-13452959.title: The effects of values-based digital microinterventions on mental health and valued living, and the role of photography and practice quality: A protocol for a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13452959.creator: Pedro Sarrión, Lorena Desdentado, Alejandro Dominguez-Rodriguez, Gerben Westerhof, Ernst Bohlmeijer, Ausiàs Cebolla, Rosa Baños
pmc-13452959.description: BackgroundValues are considered central to psychological well-being and mental health, yet the effects of brief interventions targeting valued living remain underexamined. Mobile phone-based delivery may offer a feasible way to implement values-based microinterventions in daily life, while photography may help make values more concrete and accessible.

pmc-13517155.title: Epigenetic and Epitranscriptomic Regulation of Mastitis in Dairy Cattle: A Review
pmc-13517155.creator: Shuaishuai Wu, Mohamed Tharwat, Ibrahim F. Halawani, Fuad M. Alzahrani, Khalid J. Alzahrani, Muhammad Zahoor Khan

pmc-13621353.title: Toward economically viable green hydrogen production: enhanced catalytic atom-efficiency, dual-functional systems, and non-traditional water sources
pmc-13621353.creator: Yuru Liu, Pengpeng Wu, Lin Huang, Junyan Yang, Ningning Song, Jiuyang He, Zhanjun Guo, Minmin Liang
pmc-13621353.description: The light-driven hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) represents a promising renewable energy conversion technology to combat the global energy crisis, particularly as the field shifts toward utilizing abundant water sources including wastewater and seawater rather than freshwater. However, achieving an economically viable levelized cost of hydrogen (LCOH) requires overcoming several fundamental challenges.

pmc-13629047.title: Assessing Designed Model Membrane-Targeting Peptides Found as Potential Molecular Scaffolds against Cutaneous Leishmaniasis
pmc-13629047.creator: Viviane A. C. Santana, Danúbia B. Martins, Vanessa Albuquerque, Anna Karoline Aguiar Fleuri Balbi, José Eduardo Ferraz Souza, Andre Gustavo Tempone, Marcelo Dias-Baruffi, Thalita Riul, Dayane S. Alvares, Marcia Perez dos Santos Cabrera
pmc-13629047.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Recent research has demonstrated therapeutic potential against visceral leishmaniasis, a neglected disease with high prevalence and severity in very populated low- and middle-income regions; however, effective treatments for the cutaneous or mucocutaneous forms remain limited, despite their higher incidence. The negatively charged composition of Leishmania membranes differentiates it from the zwitterionic nature of mammalian cells, providing a basis for selective targeting by cationic peptides.
